prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1075; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on this recording, if that's okay. You already have it on the claim.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the incident happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in Baytown, Texas, at a shopping center. I was pulling out of a space near the store entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was backing out slowly. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything, but when I was about halfway out, a vehicle came down the lane pretty fast and hit the rear passenger side of my car.

Q: Were you moving when the impact happened?

A: Yes, I was rolling backward at maybe three or four miles an hour. The other car was coming through the aisle.

Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?

A: Not right away. I got out, looked at the car, and felt fine for about an hour. Then my lower back started tightening up, and by that evening it was pretty painful.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed a back strain and told me to rest, take anti-inflammatories, and follow up with my doctor if it doesn't improve.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, I still have stiffness when I bend or sit for long periods. Lifting is difficult, and I've had to take time off from some of my usual activities.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm cooperating fully and I want the repair and medical costs handled properly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
